llm2.observation: Across 3216 reviews with an average rating of 3.42, high brokerage and hidden charges drove 277 complaints, while unresponsive automated support led with 313. For trade charge deductions, 26 out of 127 users found them unexpected or unclear.
actions: Display an itemized pre-trade cost breakdown showing exact brokerage, DP charges, and taxes before order placement.
Introduce quick human agent escalation within chat support when automated bots fail to resolve user queries.
Optimize release deployment schedules to decrease weekly app update frequency and resolve persistent lag issues.
explainer_bullets: Brokerage is ₹20 or 0.1% of the order value, whichever is lower, with a minimum of ₹5 per executed order.
Selling shares from the demat account attracts a DP charge: ₹16.50 charged by Groww (not charged when the debit value is under ₹100) plus ₹3.50 charged by the depository.
Intraday orders carry no DP charge.
18% GST applies on brokerage and DP charges.
Regulatory and statutory charges such as STT, stamp duty and SEBI turnover fees are listed separately on the pricing page.
